ayahOccurrences.text: قُلْ مَن يَكْلَؤُكُم بِٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ مِنَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ۗ بَلْ هُمْ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّهِم مُّعْرِضُونَ
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: قُلْ مَن يَكْلَؤُكُم بِٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ مِنَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ۗ بَلْ هُمْ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّهِم مُّعْرِضُونَ

lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: يَكْلَؤُكُم is in the derivative form: يَكْلأ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ك/ل/أ   k–l–ʾ pasture, vegetation, herbage; to guard over; to stay awake at night; shore, to bring a boat in to port. Of this root, يَكْلَؤكُم yaklaʾukum occurs 1 time in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
يَكْلأ yaklaʾ [imperf. of v. كَلأَ kalaʾa, trans.] to shelter, defend, protect, to give sanctuary to

(21:42) قُلْ مَنْ يَكْلَؤُكُمْ بِاللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ مِنَ الرَّحْمَنِ say, ‘Who could shelter you night and day other than [lit. away from] the Lord of Mercy?’
